en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small guesthouse set among trees and rocky hills. In front of the building is a fenced garden area and what appear to be sunbathing beds or platforms on the rock. A flagpole on the roof flies the Swedish flag. The house has a sign reading "PENSIONAT" above the entrance. At the bottom left of the image the caption identifies the location as "Heestrand. Pensionatet" and there is a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 9184 in the bottom right.
